edges.rationale: TestReview component is the default export defined inside TestReview.jsx.
Component declares a useEffect whose body is the fetchTestData closure.
normalizedQuestions is a useMemo declared in the component body.
userAnswers is a useMemo declared in the component body and depends on normalizedQuestions.
sectionStats useMemo is declared inside TestReview and reads userAnswers, interactiveAnswers, and reattemptMode.
getQuestionStatusClass is a helper function defined in the component scope and used by the palette grid.
changeSection is defined inside the component and bound to section tab buttons.
Practice Mode button is rendered in the header and toggles reattemptMode state in the component.
Explanations toggle button is rendered in the header and flips showExplanation state.
Language switcher button is rendered next to the section tabs and updates the language state.
The right aside element with the question palette grid is rendered as part of TestReview.
formatTimeSpent is defined inside the component and used to format the Time Taken badge.
handlePrevious, handleNext, and back-to-results handlers are defined inside the component and reused in header, footer, sidebar, and mobile nav.
The component early-returns a loading spinner and an error/empty-state panel before rendering the main UI.
The per-option button is rendered inside the Question Card block of the component.
fetchTestData calls apiClient.get with /api/tests/:testId/result[/:attemptId] to load the result payload.
apiClient.get is the only HTTP call inside fetchTestData.
TestReview reads testId and seriesId from useParams and from location.state, implying it is mounted at a route that exposes them.
useAuth() is called at the top of the component to obtain the current user for the profile card.
sanitizeHtml is imported and called on raw question, explanation, and option text before injecting with dangerouslySetInnerHTML.
Each option label is rendered via dangerouslySetInnerHTML of sanitizeHtml(option).
useNavigate, useLocation, and useParams are imported from react-router-dom.
Clock, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Menu, X, Globe, Eye, EyeOff, ArrowLeft, LayoutDashboard, RotateCcw, LayoutGrid are all imported from lucide-react.
useState, useEffect, useMemo are imported from react.
userAnswers reads normalizedQuestions to compute derived selectedOption/isCorrect values.
sectionStats iterates over currentSectionIndexes and uses userAnswers[index] when not in reattempt or solutions mode.
sectionStats branches on reattemptMode to use interactiveAnswers instead of stored userAnswers.
sectionStats treats all questions as unattempted in solutions mode.
getQuestionStatusClass switches palette colors between reattempt and normal paths.
In solutions mode the function returns neutral gray styling regardless of correctness.
Toggling the button flips the reattemptMode state variable.
Options are disabled unless reattemptMode is true; click handler only writes to interactiveAnswers in reattempt mode.
originalResponse is forced to null in solutions mode, removing the Attempt highlight.
The language state selects options[language]/text[language] which exist because normalizedQuestions keeps bilingual objects.
When showExplanation is false the option cell collapses to a single isCurrentCompared highlight and hides Attempt/Same/New/Correct badges.
The rationale explains why reattemptMode exists and how it interacts with reveal gates and color states.
The rationale describes how solutions mode suppresses user-attempt highlights as a separate code path.
handlePrevious/handleNext and back-to-results handlers call navigate from react-router-dom.
